system.description: A malicious ghost, possibly one of your own victims, torments you from beyond the grave. Though it usually limits itself to phantasmal moaning, eerie manifestations and the occasional push, it does its best to make your unlife difficult. The Storyteller creates the spirit and may assign a Narrator to follow you and ensure you pay for the Flaw.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
